name: Urvel Drath

abilities.name: Flame Spin
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Flame Whip
abilities.description: Urvel Drath forms a whip of fire with his staff and strikes you with it, dealing high flame damage. This attack has no indicator.

abilities.name: Scorched Earth
abilities.description: Urvel Drath spins his staff around for a brief moment before slamming the ground with it, causing a flaming shockwave to shoot forward, indicated by a fast moving circular AoE, dealing high flame damage and staggering you. Following the slam, several columns of basalt rock erupt from the floor to form obstacles. After a few seconds, the rocks shatter, creating small flaming wisps that home in on you and explode, dealing moderate flame damage each.

abilities.name: Rock Ring
abilities.description: Urvel Drath summons similar basalt stones to surround him for protection, accompanied by a fiery explosion, indicated by a growing circular AoE around him, dealing high flame damage. The same shattering as Scorched Earth occurs with these stones.

abilities.name: Lightning Teleport
abilities.description: Urvel Drath often teleports to the outer edge of the arena in a burst of lightning, dealing moderate shock damage if standing close to him.
